findings.message: Entry params status and page have effect filter:listaMinhasDespesas but no state holds them. Added public states `status` (ExpenseStatus | null) and `page` (number | null), both persisted; listarMinhasDespesas takes them as arguments and publishes them.
State selectedDespesa holds only the id (entry.params.despesaId) and no member selects. The selection is served by obterDespesa(id | null), which publishes the id and loads the record into `despesa`.

The defs declare no <command>.input state for registrarDespesa and salvarCorrecao (formularioDespesa). Added registrarDespesaDraft and salvarCorrecaoDraft with setters setRegistrarDespesaDraft and setSalvarCorrecaoDraft; salvarCorrecaoDraft is prefilled from `despesa`. No field for the proof (comprovante) exists in any route, so the draft has none.
registrarDespesa requires colaboradorId from the session, but the shared has no identity source. It sends an empty string and relies on the backend to bind the logged collaborator.

Command rows (item) are applied to despesas by id (insert at top for registrarDespesa, update in place otherwise, removed when the status filter no longer matches); page/hasMore of the list are not recomputed.
